nodes.description: ProvablyRareGem.gems: mapping(uint => Gem) storing gem metadata, entropy, difficulty, multiplier, crafter and manager
ProvablyRareGem.nonce: mapping(address => uint) per-miner salt counter used in luck hash
ProvablyRareGem.gemCount: number of created gem kinds, monotonically increasing
ProvablyRareGem.create: validates difficulty/gemsPerMine/multiplier/manager then creates a new gem kind
ProvablyRareGem.mine: nonReentrant mining entry point; computes luck, bumps nonce, raises difficulty and mints gems
ProvablyRareGem.updateEntropy: manager/crafter restricted setter of gems[kind].entropy
ProvablyRareGem.updateGemInfo: manager restricted setter of gem name and color
ProvablyRareGem.updateMiningData: manager restricted setter of difficulty, multiplier and gemsPerMine
ProvablyRareGem.renounceManager: manager renounces management for a list of kinds
ProvablyRareGem.updateCrafter: manager sets the crafter address for a list of kinds
ProvablyRareGem.transferManager: sets pendingManager for a list of kinds
ProvablyRareGem.acceptManager: pending manager accepts management for a list of kinds
ProvablyRareGem.craft: nonReentrant crafter-only minting of gemsPerMine (or explicit amount) to a recipient
ProvablyRareGem.luck: view mining randomness hash over chainid, entropy, address(this), msg.sender, kind, nonce and salt
ProvablyRareGem._create: internal gem kind creation, increments gemCount and writes gems mapping
ProvablyRareGem.uri: builds on-chain SVG/base64 metadata from gem state
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for nonce, ownership/manager/crafter checks and mint recipient
ERC1155 _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck: external call to IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received on the mint recipient
LOOTGemCrafter.NFT: immutable LOOT ERC721 contract used for ownership checks
LOOTGemCrafter.GEM: immutable ProvablyRareGem contract used for crafting gems
LOOTGemCrafter.FIRST_KIND: immutable first gem kind created by this contract
LOOTGemCrafter.hashseed: seed set once at start() from blockhash and used for airdrop randomness
LOOTGemCrafter.crafted: mapping(kind => amount) owner craft accounting capped at 10% of supply
LOOTGemCrafter.claimed: mapping(nftId => bool) one-time claim flag
LOOTGemCrafter constructor: stores NFT/GEM, records FIRST_KIND and creates the ten initial gem kinds
LOOTGemCrafter.start: onlyOwner activation that derives hashseed from blockhash(block.number-1) and sets gem entropy
LOOTGemCrafter.craft: nonReentrant onlyOwner crafting with 10% of total supply cap
LOOTGemCrafter.airdrop: view deterministic gem distribution derived from hashseed and NFT id
LOOTGemCrafter.claim: nonReentrant single-NFT welcome pack claim
LOOTGemCrafter.multiClaim: nonReentrant batch claim over a list of NFT ids
LOOTGemCrafter._claim: internal claim logic verifying NFT ownership, setting claimed flag and minting airdrop gems
hashseed derivation from blockhash(block.number - 1) inside start(): miner-influenceable weak randomness source
External call to NFT.ownerOf(id) on an untrusted ERC721 contract inside _claim
Loop of external GEM.craft(kinds[idx], 0, msg.sender) calls inside _claim, each triggering mint callbacks
ReentrancyGuard._status: reentrancy lock state (1 = NOT_ENTERED, 2 = ENTERED)
ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier: sets and clears _status around the guarded function body
create() implicit return kind value from _create
create() difficulty parameter validated to 1..2**128
create() gemsPerMine parameter validated to 1..1e6
create() multiplier parameter validated to 1e4..1e10
create() crafter address stored in the Gem struct
create() manager address validated non-zero and stored in the Gem struct
mine() salt parameter hashed into the luck value
mine() local val = luck(kind, salt) compared against max/diff
mine() kind parameter selecting the gem to mine
ProvablyRareGem.craft() kind parameter checked against gemCount
ProvablyRareGem.craft() amount parameter, 0 means gemsPerMine
ProvablyRareGem.craft() recipient of the minted gems
craft() local realAmount = amount == 0 ? gemsPerMine : amount
updateEntropy() kind parameter checked against gemCount
updateEntropy() entropy bytes32 written into gems[kind].entropy
LOOTGemCrafter.craft() kind parameter forwarded to GEM.craft
LOOTGemCrafter.craft() amount parameter, must be non-zero, added to crafted[kind]
claim() NFT id claimed for the caller
multiClaim() array of NFT ids iterated for claiming
airdrop() NFT id used to derive deterministic gem kinds
airdrop() local uint[4] result initialized to FIRST_KIND
airdrop() local seed = keccak256(hashseed, offset, id) driving chance checks
_claim() NFT id being claimed
transferManager() array of gem kinds whose pendingManager is set
transferManager() pending manager destination address
updateCrafter() array of gem kinds whose crafter is updated
updateCrafter() new crafter address applied to each kind
